TEXT: Two days after the field trip ended.
I went to Akihabara on my day off to give Saori some souvenirs.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: She told me over the phone that she also had something to talk about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What could she be wanting to talk to me about?
The only thing I could think of, naturally, was otaku-related stuff.
For example, things like, "This model is limited to one per person, so I would like you to come with me!".
Or maybe, "I bought a life-size figurine, help me carry it!"
It has to be something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: Hey-! Kyousuke-shi～!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ah, my sincerest apologies! The preparations took me longer than I thought they would.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's okay, I just got here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Wait, what's with those bags?
What's she planning? Is she going to go to war with those huge things?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Here, give me some of those bags, they look heavy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Don't be concerned, I have it under control!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: With that said, shall we depart to a cafe or some such in lieu of idly standing around?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: By a cafe you mean...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Heh heh heh...
When she gives this catty smile...
It definitely means we're going there...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...A maid cafe, of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAID
TEXT: Welcome back, Master, Mistress.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Phew... There... we... go...
Saori's backpack looks pretty heavy. I wonder what's inside?
...Oh yeah...
Oh right, the souvenirs...! I should give them to her...
That's what I thought, but this stuff she's carrying...
Just looking at it, it seemed like it's at least 2 or 3 kilos...
We still have places to go.ãééMaybe I should wait until we part ways.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Here, your souvenirs. Although I couldn't get what you wanted...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How about this! Limited edition regional robot model available only in Kyoto!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ah... Not bad...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This model does indeed make my heart just leap! It's brimming with an aura of the old capital, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh? You don't like it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: By no means! That's not it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Then what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm beyond grateful for your good will, but I am in no position to accept it at the present time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: At the present time? Ah, because you're going shopping afterwards, so it will unduly increase your total cargo?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's all right. I'll hold on to it until you're done shopping.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, it's not that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What is it? Just tell me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: If I accept it, it might 【never come true】.
What    are    you    saying!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What does that even mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If you don't like the gift... you should just say so, if it was because I didn't get what you asked.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, that's nowhere close to the case!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I have the utmost gratitude for your gift.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But, for now it's not possible for me to accept...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm...
Looks like it's not because she doesn't like the souvenir...
But if that's the case, I have no idea what's going on.
It'll "never come true" if she accepts it... what's up with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This can't be counted as compensation...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: As a replacement...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What!? Don't suddenly place those bags on the table!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, it's been on my mind from the start, but what's inside?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Nothing much! It is just my trifling gift.
Saori rummaged through her backpack and took out something...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Th-This is...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It is as you see,  my humble collection!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: All of them rare and premium goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...It may not be much, but I gather that Kyousuke-shi would be interested in it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This development is too sudden, and I can't get a grip. Can you explain what's going on from the beginning?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well, it is like this and that, et cetera...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see, so that's why it's like this and that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Tsk, this isn't a manga or game, how would I know!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahaha!
Damn... This person's having fun at my expense...
...I took a look at another one on the table.
Each and every one of them are either limited editions or out of print; they are basically collector's items.
This figure is so hard to obtain that you can only find it in auctions...
And this game is autographed by the voice actress...?!
Aside from that, there are two beam sabers sticking out of her backpack...
It's as if the pair of white blades are extending to the heavens...
...No, wait. I have seen this somewhere...
What? It's not part of the trophy rewards from that competition?
No, no, that was just for the sabers.
Even so, I have no idea what Saori's intentions are, letting go of all these collectible goods...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't this the tournament prize from before? We split it among ourselves.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That's right! One of the finest pieces in my collection, filled with memories from that day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Aren't these all the things that you treasure the most?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, certainly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't say it so lightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If it's that important, then keep it properly, and don't just give it to others.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wh-What is it, getting serious all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: It is precisely because these are 【truly valuable things】, that I would like you to have them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wait, I don't get it at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Now now, at any rate...
